title: People who help us
examples: Who helps us when we are sick?
What do we do if we get lost?

explain.say: Today we learn about people who help our community.
A doctor helps us when we feel poorly or hurt.
If we need to see a grown-up, we can ask a parent.
If we see something scary, we should tell a trusted adult.
When you are playing and fall down, a nurse at the playground will help you feel better. She knows how to clean your scrape and put a bandage on it. She helps keep you safe while you play.

draw.text: Nurse helps when we get hurt.

faq.q: Who helps us when we are hurt?
faq.a: A doctor or a nurse helps us when we are hurt. They know how to make us feel better.
asks: Who takes care of sick people?

faq.q: If I am lost, who should I look for?
faq.a: You should look for a police officer or a kind grown-up. They can help you find your family.
asks: Who helps if I wander off?
Who do I ask if I am lost?

faq.a: A community helper is any person who helps keep our town safe and working. Firefighters and teachers are helpers.

faq.q: Can I ask anyone for help?
faq.a: It is best to ask a trusted adult like a parent or teacher. They know how to help you safely.
asks: Can I ask strangers for help?

faq.a: The firefighters help us by putting out big fires. They wear big yellow coats to keep safe.
asks: Who drives the big red truck?

facts: Doctors work in clinics and hospitals.
We should always tell a trusted adult if we are scared.
Police officers help keep our streets safe.

quiz.say: If you see smoke, who should you call for help?
quiz.why: Firefighters have the big red trucks and know how to stop fires.

wrong.1: Doctors help with sickness, not with fire.
wrong.2: Teachers help us learn in the classroom.
wrong.3: Police officers help keep us safe on the street.

quiz.say: When you feel a tummy ache, who can help you?
quiz.why: Doctors and nurses know how to check your tummy and help you feel better.

wrong.0: Shopkeepers help us buy food and toys.
wrong.1: Bus drivers take us to different places.
wrong.2: We need a grown-up who knows about health.

quiz.say: If you are lost in the park, who is a good person to ask?
quiz.why: A police officer or a parent is a trusted adult who can help you find your way.

wrong.0: You should not talk to people you do not know.
wrong.1: Puppies are cute, but they cannot help you find your way.
wrong.2: Shop workers are busy selling things.
